Mark relevant when substantive journalism directly covers the member, including official actions or policy work, campaign activity, debates, forum attendance or absence, interviews, questionnaires, profiles, awards, or staffing. Do not reject journalistic coverage of a campaign, debate, or forum as promotion. Mark unrelated stories, incidental mentions, opinion pieces, editorials, endorsements, routine greetings, and self-published promotional items as not relevant. Use only the supplied case IDs and return a JSON object with decisions, each exactly {id, relevant}. Do not produce quotes, headlines, URLs, explanations, or facts.
